description: Protogrid is a public registry of MCP servers. Describe a task in plain words and it finds matching servers from the official MCP registry, tells you how each one connects (no sign-in, an API key, OAuth or a local package), and returns a ready-to-use configuration for clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or VS Code. Every server shows its tools, a change history of its tool definitions, and trust and quality scores built from our own credential-free checks. You can also check any remote MCP server URL for protocol support and directory readiness. protogrid is read-only: it never calls third-party tools and never asks for your credentials. Scores come from observable signals; no audit is implied.
